falsification_conditions.condition: Primary risk asset (BTC if crypto-led, else SPX) closes ≥12% above today's close and finishes above its 50-day moving average for 5 consecutive sessions within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: HOLD/UNKNOWN is wrong: the tape already resolved into an uptrend, so a May-2022-Luna capitulation-bottom analog no longer describes the regime

falsification_conditions.condition: Primary risk asset prints a daily close ≥10% below the low of the window that produced the 79% bottom_2022_may_luna match
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom-pattern call is invalidated: the analog's local low failed and the market is still in an unresolved decline, not a washout bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints ≥70, or 30-day realized vol falls below 25 while perpetual funding stays positive (>0.03% per 8h) for 5 straight days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Capitulation-bottom similarity is false: positioning and vol show euphoria or a completed squeeze, not a Luna-style bottom, so HOLD on that pattern is the wrong call

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
